A closed-loop control system uses feedback, meaning the output affects the input to regulate system behavior.  
An open-loop system has no feedback; the output does not influence the input.  
The question states: "The output of the system has an effect upon the input quantity" — this is the definition of feedback, so it must be a closed-loop system.  
Option (A) is incorrect because open-loop systems lack this feature.  
Option (C) is incorrect because it cannot be open-loop.  
Option (D) is incorrect because closed-loop is the correct match.  

Final answer: (B)
